question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obliterate
solution:
The correct answer is “**Erase**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Obliterate**' means to destroy completely; wipe out.(मिटा देना)

 
 
• **Example**- The hurricane obliterated the coastal village.
 
 
 
• '**Erase**' means to rub out or remove written or printed matter.(मिटा दो)
 
 
• **Example**- She tried to erase the painful memories from her mind.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word 'obliterate' is 'Erase'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **‘Option 1’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options:
 
• **Assist**: To help someone. (मदद करना)
 
• **Construct**: To build or create. (निर्माण करना)
 
• **Create**: Bring into existence. (रचना करना)
